title: Dicey Dungeons: Lady Luck and the newly transformed warrior
studio: Terry Cavanagh, Marlowe Dobbe and Chipzel
summary: An official dialogue GIF gives a clear comparison between composed, knowing attention and open excitement in the same scene.

observations.text: In the inspected GIF frame, Lady Luck has a half-lidded sideways eye, a high curved brow and a small angular smile. The warrior has open eyes, raised brows and an open grin. Their attitudes remain distinct at a glance.

The facial contrast is supported by gesture: Lady Luck presents an open palm while the warrior holds his sword up. Only a sampled GIF frame was inspected; this does not establish timing or lip-sync behavior.

mistIdeas: Our inference: build a mildly amused listening pose around eyelid height and sideways gaze, then keep that eye pose while the mouth changes for speech.
Our inference: distinguish alert delight from ordinary warmth with eye opening and brow height before increasing mouth size. Avoid giving every positive state the warrior's excited grin.

media.alt: Lady Luck's half-lidded expression contrasts with the warrior's open-eyed grin during dialogue.

title: Spiritfarer: individuality within a shared action set
summary: The animators explain how common actions can carry distinct personalities, a useful foundation for MIST's event-driven reactions.

observations.text: Boyer and Pelletier describe a largely shared action list for the spirits, including interaction, eating, sleeping and hugging, while making each spirit's movement individual.

The interview identifies dialogue expressions among Stella's animation work. It also describes returning control once an action has communicated its meaning, allowing the player to cancel into another action.

mistIdeas: Our inference: give MIST a common reaction structure with expression-specific gaze, eyelids and recovery, rather than using the same bounce for every event.

Our inference: define the minimum visible beat of a reaction and let a new conversational event interrupt its tail. Preserve the emotional eye pose when speech begins instead of resetting the face to neutral.

title: Spiritfarer animated trailer: Stella holding Daffodil
studio: Knights of the Light Table for Thunder Lotus
summary: A supplied close-up communicates affection with a small closed-mouth smile and attentive eyes, rather than a broad grin.

observations.text: In the inspected close-up, Stella's pupils point upward and left, her mouth forms a small closed smile, and her arms enclose Daffodil. The face and protective gesture carry the same gentle attitude.
The creators attribute the trailer's emotional effect to small facial changes and body language, supported by color, lighting, music and timing.

mistIdeas: Our inference: test a quiet contentment state with a small mouth curve, stable upward gaze and a modest head angle. Keep ample space between this and a delighted grin.
Our inference: preserve an emotional eye-and-brow pose across talking mouth shapes. The still suggests this separation as a design approach; it does not prove the trailer uses such a rig.

title: Cult of the Lamb: studio-published follower reaction

people.name: Jan F Sorrentino
people.role: Animator at Massive Monster; maker of Doom & Shroom fan-animation

summary: A studio-posted rabbit follower reaction separates a strongly readable eye design from a changing small mouth.

observations.text: Two inspected frames show the rabbit with very large dark oval eyes and thin pale vertical pupils. Its mouth changes from a small tooth-bearing shape to an open smile while its hands stay near its chest.
In the second inspected frame, a foreground finger points toward the rabbit. This grounds the reaction in an interaction, although isolated screenshots do not establish the precise sequence or cause.

mistIdeas: Our inference: use a stable, recognizable eye design with a small number of clear mouth changes so talking does not erase the face's identity.
Our inference: attach reactions to a visible or audible event and give attention a target. Do not copy the follower's extreme eye proportions into every MIST state.
